capabilities: Import and display events from public iCalendar URLs and local ICS files
Show a monthly calendar grid and daily agenda in the sidebar
Create templated notes from events with date-based folder organization
Embed calendar and agenda views in notes via code blocks
Filter attendees by CUTYPE and create wiki links for attendees
extras: README lists current limitations: remote calendars must be publicly accessible (no authentication), no bi-directional sync, local ICS files are not auto-watched, and views are monthly with agenda only.
motivation: The author wanted to bridge the gap between personal knowledge management and time management inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar that shows your schedule or turns calendar events into linked, templated notes.
summary: Calendar plugin that displays events from public iCalendar URLs or local ICS files and creates templated notes for those events.
